create.name: The Threshold Society
create.bio:
The Threshold Society is a Sufi community and non-profit teaching foundation in the Mevlevi tradition, the path that traces back to the poet Jalaluddin Rumi. It was founded by Kabir Helminski and his wife Camille Adams Helminski, who have practised in that lineage for some forty years. Kabir studied with Suleyman Hayati Dede of Konya and was recognised as a shaikh of the Mevlevi Order in 1990; the couple earlier started Threshold Books, which brought many classic Sufi texts and Rumi translations into English, and both have written and translated widely, Camille's work giving particular attention to women in Sufism.

Its teaching rests on classical Sufism and the Qur'an, read as a practical path of presence, remembrance and love that is open to seekers of any background. On the first Sunday of each month the founders and senior students lead a free online meditation and talk, and these are posted on its YouTube channel, which began in 2012. The society also runs the Mysterion School, a year-long online study programme, guided e-retreats on Rumi and the Divine Names, a phone app of daily reminders, and occasional retreats in California and England.

courses.title: On-demand online retreats (e-courses)
courses.description: Self-paced e-retreats by Kabir and Camille Helminski and their students, run with Spirituality & Practice: daily emails, readings and recordings over thirty to forty-nine days on Rumi, the Ninety-Nine Names, remembrance and presence.

free_resources.title: Sunday Meditation
free_resources.description: A free online gathering on the first Sunday of every month, with meditation and a talk led by Kabir and Camille Helminski and members of the community, on Zoom.

free_resources.title: Podcasts
free_resources.description: Recorded talks and readings, many by Kabir Helminski, including Mathnawi readings and festival lectures, to stream or download.

free_resources.title: HeartSpace app
free_resources.description: A free iPhone app from the society that sends short daily reminders drawn from Rumi, the Hadith and the Qur'an.

free_resources.title: Monthly Essential Practices of Mevlevi Spirituality for 2026
free_resources.description: A theme for each month of the year, with a line from the Qur'an, Imam Ali or the society's teachers to carry into daily practice.
